description: #53 CRIT-2 and CRIT-3: a private repository at Repair whose plan has lapsed, as #17's lapse simulation read it: the rules read answers 403, so the private item fails with the lapse remedies.

habit_lines: GitHub 拒绝了这个 private 仓库的 rulesets 读取：Habit130 的 GitHub Pro 不在生效状态，所以这里的 rulesets 不能用，规则没有生效。
解决办法二选一：续期 GitHub Education 学生认证，或者把这个仓库改为 public。
rules_in_effect.issue_line: Rules not in effect on Habit130/tally: GitHub refused the agent account's rules read with 403 ("Upgrade to GitHub Pro or make this repository public to enable this feature."), so the plan has lapsed. Remedy: renew the student verification, or make the repository public.
